text: An adjunction F ⊣ G between functors F: C → D and G: D → C is a natural bijection of the form:
choices: Hom_D(FA, B) ≅ Hom_C(A, GB), natural in A and B
explanation: An adjunction F ⊣ G ('F left adjoint to G') is precisely the natural bijection Hom_D(FA, B) ≅ Hom_C(A, GB). It is weaker than an equivalence (C would require the composites to be identities), and the free–forgetful pair Grp/Set is the paradigm. Option D places the hom-set on the wrong side.
